verdict.rationale: Snowpipe is Snowflake's own documented feature for loading files as soon as they land in a stage. It runs in continuous micro-batches with data available within minutes, so you no longer run scheduled COPY statements yourself. That covers the core of the story for file-based ingestion. missing for 10: evidence of continuous event/streaming ingestion (not just staged files), explicit documentation that Snowpipe runs on serverless or managed compute with no user infrastructure, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Snowpipe in practice.
